intended_object: A bit-string encoding of an input for a Turing-machine construction: a raw rational increment paired with an encoded square rational matrix. Inferred from the docstring and from how the module uses it.
explanation: The definition pairs the binary code of a raw rational with the library's binary encoding of a square rational matrix. It builds the input word fed to the library's own "matrix add delta" machine, and the library uses it only in correctness proofs for that machine (MachineMatrixAddDelta.lean and MachineSmoothedMatrix.lean). It is an internal encoding choice made to set up complexity-theoretic arguments. It has no counterpart in standard mathematics against which faithfulness could be judged.
